zh_en_a2_1_connectors.title: 连词 because / so / but

subjects.display: 天冷，所以我们待在家里。
她高兴，因为她通过了考试。
我迟到了，因为公交车没来。
我买了票，但把它忘在家里了。
她很累，因为她工作到很晚。
火车晚点了，所以我们等了一个小时。
他想买那辆车，但太贵了。
我们没出去，因为天气太冷。

sentences.sentence: 我很累，所以早睡了。 → I was tired, ____ I went to bed early.
sentences.referenceExample: I was tired, **so** I went to bed early.

sentences.sentence: 我没去，因为下雨了。 → I didn't go ____ it rained.
我想去，但我很忙。 → I wanted to go, ____ I was busy.
sentences.referenceExample: I wanted to go, **but** I was busy.

sentences.sentence: 她饿了，所以做了饭。 → She was hungry, ____ she cooked.
他学习了，但没通过。 → He studied, ____ he didn't pass.
天冷，所以我们待在家里。 → It was cold, ____ we stayed at home.
sentences.english: 天冷，所以我们待在家里。
sentences.referenceExample: It was cold, **so** we stayed at home.

sentences.sentence: 她高兴，因为她通过了考试。 → She was happy ____ she passed the exam.
sentences.english: 她高兴，因为她通过了考试。
sentences.referenceExample: She was happy **because** she passed the exam.

sentences.sentence: 这家餐馆很好，但很贵。 → The restaurant was good, ____ expensive.
我迟到了，因为公交车没来。 → I was late ____ the bus didn't come.
sentences.english: 我迟到了，因为公交车没来。
sentences.referenceExample: I was late **because** the bus didn't come.

sentences.sentence: 他没带伞，所以淋湿了。 → He didn't have an umbrella, ____ he got wet.
sentences.referenceExample: He didn't have an umbrella, **so** he got wet.

sentences.sentence: 我买了票，但把它忘在家里了。 → I bought the ticket, ____ I left it at home.
sentences.english: 我买了票，但把它忘在家里了。
sentences.referenceExample: I bought the ticket, **but** I left it at home.

sentences.sentence: 她很累，因为她工作到很晚。 → She was tired ____ she worked late.
sentences.english: 她很累，因为她工作到很晚。
sentences.referenceExample: She was tired **because** she worked late.

sentences.sentence: 火车晚点了，所以我们等了一个小时。 → The train was late, ____ we waited an hour.
sentences.english: 火车晚点了，所以我们等了一个小时。
sentences.referenceExample: The train was late, **so** we waited an hour.

sentences.sentence: 他想买那辆车，但太贵了。 → He wanted to buy the car, ____ it was too expensive.
sentences.english: 他想买那辆车，但太贵了。
sentences.referenceExample: He wanted to buy the car, **but** it was too expensive.

sentences.sentence: 我们没出去，因为天气太冷。 → We didn't go out ____ it was too cold.
sentences.english: 我们没出去，因为天气太冷。
sentences.referenceExample: We didn't go out **because** it was too cold.

zh_en_a2_1_connectors.helpMemoryIntro: 用 because（因为）、so（所以）、but（但是）连接句子。

helpMemoryTips.title: ⚠️ 一句一个连词（Z25）
helpMemoryTips.text: 中文说「因为…所以…」，英语只能用一个：I was tired, **so** I left（不要再加 because）。

zh_en_a2_1_dict_weekend.title: 听写：Last weekend

subjects.english: 他们参观了一家博物馆。

subjects.display: They were in Shanghai last week.

zh_en_a2_1_dict_weekend.helpMemoryIntro: 听句子并打出来。重点是过去式的 -ed 和不规则动词。

helpMemoryTips.title: ⚠️ 写出过去式（Z17）
helpMemoryTips.text: 注意 -ed（watched, played, visited）和不规则（went）——别写成原形。

zh_en_a2_1_did.title: 过去时的疑问与否定：did / didn't

subjects.display: 她昨晚给你打电话了吗？
火车旅程花了多长时间？

sentences.sentence: 你昨天见到他了吗？ → ____ you see him yesterday?
我没去上班。 → I ____ go to work.
她昨晚给你打电话了吗？ → ____ she call you last night?
sentences.english: 她昨晚给你打电话了吗？

sentences.sentence: 他们不喜欢那部电影。 → They ____ like the film.
你周末做什么了？ → What ____ you do at the weekend?
sentences.referenceExample: What **did** you do at the weekend?

sentences.sentence: 他昨天来了吗？ → ____ he come yesterday?
我们没看那场比赛。 → We ____ watch the match.
你们在哪儿吃的饭？ → Where ____ you eat?
她没买那条裙子。 → She ____ buy the dress.
你什么时候到的？ → When ____ you arrive?
你为什么没来？ → Why ____ you come?
他吃早饭了吗？ → ____ he have breakfast?
我昨晚没睡好。 → I ____ sleep well last night.
火车旅程花了多长时间？ → How long ____ the journey take?
sentences.english: 火车旅程花了多长时间？

sentences.sentence: 她没告诉我她的名字。 → She ____ tell me her name.

zh_en_a2_1_did.helpMemoryIntro: 过去时的疑问和否定要借助 did，主要动词回到原形。

helpMemoryTips.title: ⚠️ did + 原形（Z14）
helpMemoryTips.text: Did you **go**? / I **didn't go**——did 已表示过去，主要动词用原形（不是 went）。

zh_en_a2_1_listen_trip.title: 听力：A short trip
zh_en_a2_1_listen_trip.helpMemoryIntro: 先听，再答题。注意天气和原因。

helpMemoryTips.title: 听 so 表原因结果
helpMemoryTips.text: …it started to rain, **so** she came home early——so 引出结果。

zh_en_a2_1_listen_trip.readingPassage: Yesterday, Mei took a day trip to a small town in the mountains. She left home early and took the bus. The journey took two hours. When she arrived, the weather was cold and windy. She walked around the old streets and had lunch in a small restaurant. She bought some local tea. In the afternoon, it started to rain, so she came home early.
zh_en_a2_1_listen_trip.readingPassageTranslation: 昨天，Mei 去山里的一个小镇一日游。她一早就出发，坐了公交车，路上花了两个小时。到的时候天气又冷又刮风。她在古老的街道上走了走，在一家小餐馆吃了午饭，还买了一些当地的茶。下午下起了雨，所以她提前回家了。

readingQuestions.question: What was the weather like when she arrived?
readingQuestions.questionTranslation: 她到的时候天气怎么样？

readingQuestions.question: Why did she come home early?

zh_en_a2_1_listen_weekend.title: 听力：My weekend
zh_en_a2_1_listen_weekend.helpMemoryIntro: 先听，再答题。留意所有的过去式动词。

helpMemoryTips.title: 听过去式
helpMemoryTips.text: went, played, had, watched, stayed, read, cooked——都是过去式。

zh_en_a2_1_listen_weekend.readingPassage: Last weekend was great. On Saturday, I went to the park with my friends. We played football and had a picnic. In the evening, we watched a film. On Sunday, I stayed at home. I read a book and cooked dinner for my family. I didn't study, so today I'm a bit busy!
zh_en_a2_1_listen_weekend.readingPassageTranslation: 上个周末很棒。周六我和朋友们去了公园。我们踢了足球，还野餐了。晚上我们看了一部电影。周日我待在家里，读了一本书，还给家人做了晚饭。我没学习，所以今天有点忙！

readingQuestions.question: What did they do on Saturday?
What did the speaker do on Sunday?
options: Watched a film in the cinema

zh_en_a2_1_past_irreg.title: 一般过去时：不规则动词

subjects.display: 我今天早上收到了一封信。

sentences.sentence: 昨天我去了学校。 → I ____ to school yesterday.
她昨晚有很多作业。 → She ____ a lot of homework.
我们看见了一个明星。 → We ____ a film star.
他吃了三个苹果。 → He ____ three apples.
我买了一本新书。 → I ____ a new book.
他们来晚了。 → They ____ late.
她做了一个蛋糕。 → She ____ a cake.
他告诉了我这个消息。 → He ____ me the news.
我今天早上收到了一封信。 → I ____ a letter this morning.
sentences.english: 我今天早上收到了一封信。

sentences.sentence: 我们坐了火车。 → We ____ the train.
我昨晚睡得很好。（sleep→slept） → I ____ well last night.
她给我写了一封长信。（write→wrote） → She ____ me a long letter.
他们上周五离开了。（leave→left） → They ____ last Friday.
我在车站遇见了她。（meet→met） → I ____ her at the station.
他喝了两杯咖啡。（drink→drank） → He ____ two cups of coffee.

zh_en_a2_1_past_irreg.helpMemoryIntro: 最常用的动词往往是不规则的，必须一个个背下来。

helpMemoryTips.title: 高频不规则动词
helpMemoryTips.text: go→went，have→had，see→saw，eat→ate，make→made，come→came，buy→bought，tell→told，get→got。

zh_en_a2_1_past_reg.title: 一般过去时：规则动词 -ed

subjects.display: 我们上周参观了博物馆。
我昨晚给妈妈打了电话。
他在那家公司工作了两年。
我昨晚很早就睡了。（decide 规则变化）
他们在公园里聊了很久。（chat → 双写）
她试穿了那条裙子。（try → ied）
我们昨天帮助了一位老人。

sentences.sentence: 昨天我学习了英语。 → I ____ English yesterday.
她昨晚看了电视。 → She ____ TV last night.
我们上周参观了博物馆。 → We ____ a museum last week.
sentences.english: 我们上周参观了博物馆。

sentences.sentence: 他们昨天踢了足球。 → They ____ football yesterday.
他两小时前到的。 → He ____ two hours ago.
她在门口停下了。 → She ____ at the door.
我昨晚给妈妈打了电话。 → I ____ my mother last night.
sentences.english: 我昨晚给妈妈打了电话。

sentences.sentence: 他在那家公司工作了两年。 → He ____ at that company for two years.
sentences.english: 他在那家公司工作了两年。
sentences.referenceExample: He **worked** at that company for two years.

sentences.sentence: 我们昨天打扫了房间。 → We ____ the room yesterday.
她打开了窗户。 → She ____ the window.
我昨晚很早就睡了。（decide 规则变化） → I ____ to sleep early last night.
sentences.english: 我昨晚很早就睡了。（decide 规则变化）
sentences.referenceExample: I **decided** to sleep early last night.

sentences.sentence: 他们在公园里聊了很久。（chat → 双写） → They ____ for a long time in the park.
sentences.english: 他们在公园里聊了很久。（chat → 双写）
sentences.referenceExample: They **chatted** for a long time in the park.

sentences.sentence: 她试穿了那条裙子。（try → ied） → She ____ on the dress.
sentences.english: 她试穿了那条裙子。（try → ied）

sentences.sentence: 音乐会八点开始。（start） → The concert ____ at eight.
我们昨天帮助了一位老人。 → We ____ an old man yesterday.
sentences.english: 我们昨天帮助了一位老人。

zh_en_a2_1_past_reg.helpMemoryIntro: 英语用动词加 -ed 表示过去。中文靠「了」和时间词，动词本身不变——这是关键区别。

helpMemoryTips.title: ⚠️ 过去 = 动词变形（Z17）
helpMemoryTips.text: 中文「昨天我去」动词不变，英语必须变：I **worked**、I **studied**。时间在过去，动词就要变。

helpMemoryTips.title: 拼写
helpMemoryTips.text: 一般加 -ed；-e 结尾加 -d（live→lived）；辅音+y → ied（study→studied）；重读闭音节双写（stop→stopped）。

zh_en_a2_1_read_abroad.title: 阅读：Lin's first week abroad
zh_en_a2_1_read_abroad.helpMemoryIntro: 读一段关于适应海外生活的短文。全篇用过去时叙述。

helpMemoryTips.title: 过去式叙事
helpMemoryTips.text: moved, was, got, arrived, missed, made——注意 got better（变得更好）。英式拼写 grey。

zh_en_a2_1_read_abroad.readingPassage: Lin moved to London last month to study English. Her first week was difficult. On the first day, she got lost and arrived late for class. The weather was cold and grey, and she missed her family. But things soon got better. She made new friends from many countries. They cooked dinner together and practised English. By the end of the week, Lin felt happy. "London is my new home," she thought.
zh_en_a2_1_read_abroad.readingPassageTranslation: Lin 上个月搬到伦敦学英语。她的第一周很艰难。第一天她迷了路，上课迟到了。天气又冷又阴，她很想家。但情况很快好转了。她结识了来自许多国家的新朋友。他们一起做饭、练习英语。到那周结束时，Lin 感到很快乐。「伦敦是我的新家。」她心想。

readingQuestions.question: Why did Lin move to London?
How did she feel in the first week?

zh_en_a2_1_read_shanghai.title: 阅读：A weekend in Shanghai
zh_en_a2_1_read_shanghai.helpMemoryIntro: 读一段周末游记。留意不规则过去式（took, went, bought）。

helpMemoryTips.title: 不规则动词
helpMemoryTips.text: arrive→arrived（规则），但 take→took、go→went、buy→bought 是不规则的。

zh_en_a2_1_read_shanghai.readingPassage: Last weekend, Wei visited Shanghai with his family. They arrived on Friday evening and stayed in a small hotel near the river. On Saturday, they walked along the Bund and took many photos. In the afternoon, they went shopping on Nanjing Road. Wei bought a present for his grandmother. On Sunday, they visited a museum and then took the train home. It was a busy but wonderful weekend.
zh_en_a2_1_read_shanghai.readingPassageTranslation: 上个周末，Wei 和家人游览了上海。他们周五晚上到达，住在江边一家小旅馆。周六他们沿着外滩散步，拍了很多照片。下午他们在南京路购物。Wei 给奶奶买了一份礼物。周日他们参观了一家博物馆，然后坐火车回家。这是一个忙碌但美好的周末。

zh_en_a2_1_speak_ed.title: 发音：-ed 的三种读音

subjects.display: I watched a film and visited a friend.

zh_en_a2_1_speak_ed.helpMemoryIntro: -ed 有三种读音，而且常被中国学习者漏读或都读成 /ɪd/。听清楚，读出来。

helpMemoryTips.title: ⚠️ /t/ /d/ /ɪd/（Z7）
helpMemoryTips.text: 清辅音后读 /t/（worked）；浊辅音/元音后读 /d/（played）；只有 t/d 结尾才读 /ɪd/（wanted）。

zh_en_a2_1_speak_trip.title: 开口说：说说你的旅行

subjects.display: Last month, I went to Xi'an.

zh_en_a2_1_speak_trip.helpMemoryIntro: 用过去时讲一次旅行。听并跟读。

helpMemoryTips.title: 讲故事用过去时
helpMemoryTips.text: 整段都用过去式：was / went / visited。用 first, then, after that 串联。

zh_en_a2_1_speaking_close.title: 结业对话：我的故事
zh_en_a2_1_speaking_close.helpMemoryIntro: A2.1 模块的结业对话：一次关于你过去的采访。复制、开口、把分数带回来。

helpMemoryTips.title: 一个故事三步走
helpMemoryTips.text: 定场（When I was…）→ 讲事（I went, I saw）→ 收尾（In the end…）。任何往事都能套这个结构。

speaking.topic: Tell me about your past: your childhood, your school, a trip you loved, and what you did last weekend. I will ask follow-up questions.
practisePoints: Past simple, regular and irregular, in connected sentences
was/were and there was/were for descriptions
Time expressions: when I was…, ago, last…
Questions with did answered naturally
scoringCriteria: Story order with then, afterwards, in the end

zh_en_a2_1_speaking_mid.title: 对话：昨天
zh_en_a2_1_speaking_mid.helpMemoryIntro: 中段检查点：把你的昨天讲给 AI 助手听。复制、开口、把分数输回来。

helpMemoryTips.title: ⚑Z14 动词必须变形
helpMemoryTips.text: 中文说"昨天我去"，动词不变；英语必须 went。先备好三句锚点：Yesterday I went to… I had lunch with… I watched…

speaking.topic: A simple chat about what I did yesterday and last weekend: where I went, what I ate, who I saw.
practisePoints: Past simple of regular verbs with a clear -ed
Key irregulars: went, had, saw, ate, came
Time expressions: yesterday, last week, two days ago
scoringCriteria: Correct past forms, regular and irregular
did used correctly in questions and negatives
Time expressions placed correctly (ago after the period)
priorityErrors: present used instead of past (Chinese verbs don't change — English ones must)

zh_en_a2_1_time_order.title: 过去时间词与语序

subjects.display: 她上个月开始了新工作。
我们前天到的。（the day before yesterday）
她昨天晚上学习了英语。
我上周日见了我的祖父母。

sentences.sentence: 我昨天去了上海。 → I went to Shanghai ____.
她上周到的。 → She arrived last ____.
他们两年前搬走了。 → They moved away two years ____.
我今天早上见到他了。 → I saw him this ____.
我们去年去了日本。 → We went to Japan last ____.
他昨晚给我打了电话。 → He called me last ____.
我三天前买了这本书。 → I bought this book three days ____.
sentences.referenceExample: I bought this book three days **ago**.

sentences.sentence: 她上个月开始了新工作。 → She started her new job last ____.
sentences.english: 她上个月开始了新工作。
sentences.referenceExample: She started her new job last **month**.

sentences.sentence: 我们昨天下午见了面。 → We met yesterday ____.
他一小时前离开了。 → He left an hour ____.
我们前天到的。（the day before yesterday） → We arrived the day before ____.
sentences.english: 我们前天到的。（the day before yesterday）

sentences.sentence: 她昨天晚上学习了英语。 → She studied English last ____.
sentences.english: 她昨天晚上学习了英语。

sentences.sentence: 他们五分钟前出发了。 → They left five minutes ____.
我上周日见了我的祖父母。 → I saw my grandparents last ____.
sentences.english: 我上周日见了我的祖父母。

sentences.sentence: 我们今天下午买了菜。 → We bought vegetables this ____.

zh_en_a2_1_time_order.helpMemoryIntro: 英语把时间词放在**句尾**，而中文放在动词前。这是常见的语序错误。

helpMemoryTips.title: ⚠️ 时间词放句尾（Z21）
helpMemoryTips.text: 中文「我昨天去了」→ 英语 I went to Shanghai **yesterday**，不是 I yesterday went。

zh_en_a2_1_transport.title: 交通与出行 · Transport
zh_en_a2_1_transport.helpMemoryIntro: 常见交通方式。说「乘坐某交通工具」用 by + 名词（不加冠词）。

helpMemoryTips.title: by + 交通工具
helpMemoryTips.text: by bus / by train / by car（不加 a/the）；但「步行」是 on foot。英式英语「地铁」= the underground / the tube。

zh_en_a2_1_was_were.title: was / were（be 的过去式）

sentences.sentence: 我昨天很累。 → I ____ tired yesterday.
他们上周在北京。 → They ____ in Beijing last week.
天气很好。 → The weather ____ nice.
你昨晚在家吗？ → ____ you at home last night?
电影不好看。 → The film ____ good.
她小时候个子很小。 → She ____ small as a child.
我们迟到了。 → We ____ late.
街上没有人。 → There ____ no people in the street.
sentences.referenceExample: There **were** no people in the street.

sentences.sentence: 他昨天不在办公室。 → He ____ in the office yesterday.
你们在哪儿？ → ____ were you?
考试很难。 → The exam ____ difficult.
孩子们昨天在学校吗？ → ____ the children at school yesterday?
门是开着的。 → The door ____ open.
商店里人不多。 → There ____ many people in the shop.
sentences.referenceExample: There **weren't** many people in the shop.

sentences.sentence: 你小时候害羞吗？ → ____ you shy as a child?

zh_en_a2_1_was_were.helpMemoryIntro: be 动词的过去式：was（I/he/she/it）和 were（you/we/they）。

helpMemoryTips.title: 两个形式
helpMemoryTips.text: I/he/she/it → **was**；you/we/they → **were**。否定：wasn't / weren't。

zh_en_a2_1_weather.title: 天气与季节 · Weather
zh_en_a2_1_weather.helpMemoryIntro: 描述天气和四季。说天气用虚主语 It's …。

helpMemoryTips.title: It's + 天气（Z19）
helpMemoryTips.text: 说天气要有主语 it：It's sunny / It's cold。英式英语「秋天」用 autumn（不是 fall）。

zh_en_a2_2_articles.title: 冠词复习：a / an / the

subjects.display: 我有一只狗。那只狗很友好。
我在车站等你。（我们都知道哪个车站）
我昨天看了一部电影。那部电影很棒。
你能打开窗户吗？（我们都知道哪扇）
天空是蓝色的。（独一无二）

sentences.sentence: 我有一只狗。那只狗很友好。 → I have a dog. ____ dog is friendly.
sentences.english: 我有一只狗。那只狗很友好。
sentences.referenceExample: I have a dog. **The** dog is friendly.

sentences.sentence: 太阳很亮。 → ____ sun is bright.
她是一名医生。 → She's ____ doctor.
请关上门。 → Please close ____ door.
这是一个好主意。 → It's ____ good idea.
她会弹钢琴。 → She can play ____ piano.
我在车站等你。（我们都知道哪个车站） → I'll wait for you at ____ station.
sentences.english: 我在车站等你。（我们都知道哪个车站）
sentences.referenceExample: I'll wait for you at **the** station.

sentences.sentence: 他买了一部新手机。 → He bought ____ new phone.
月亮今晚很圆。 → ____ moon is full tonight.
她吃了一个鸡蛋。 → She ate ____ egg.

天空是蓝色的。（独一无二） → ____ sky is blue.
sentences.english: 天空是蓝色的。（独一无二）

sentences.sentence: 她住在一个小村庄里。 → She lives in ____ small village.

zh_en_a2_2_articles.helpMemoryIntro: 再练冠词：初次提到用 a/an，再次提到或双方都知道的用 the。

helpMemoryTips.title: ⚠️ a vs the（Z11）
helpMemoryTips.text: a = 初次、众多之一；the = 我们都知道的那一个、独一无二（the sun）。泛指复数/不可数用零冠词。

zh_en_a2_2_bigtext.title: 整段填空：Moving day plans
zh_en_a2_2_bigtext.helpMemoryIntro: 完成短文：进行时、going to、will、比较级和 some/any。

helpMemoryTips.title: 每个空问自己一句
helpMemoryTips.text: 正在发生（-ing）？已定计划（going to）？当场承诺（will）？还是比较（-er / most）？

zh_en_a2_2_bigtext.readingPassage: Tom is packing his boxes right now because he is going to move to Manchester next week. His new flat is bigger than his old one, and the rent is cheaper. "I will visit you in the summer," says Emma. "Great! It is the best city for music in the country," Tom says. He still needs some boxes for his books — he has too many of them. Tomorrow his friends will help him with the van, and then they are going to eat pizza together. "Don't worry," says Li Ming, "moving day will be fun."
zh_en_a2_2_bigtext.readingPassageTranslation: Tom 此刻正在打包箱子，因为下周他要搬去曼彻斯特。新公寓比旧的大，房租也更便宜。"夏天我会去看你的，"Emma 说。"太好了！那是全国音乐最棒的城市，"Tom 说。他还需要一些装书的箱子——书实在太多了。明天朋友们会开面包车来帮忙，然后他们要一起吃披萨。"别担心，"李明说，"搬家那天会很有意思的。"

zh_en_a2_2_comparatives.title: 比较级：-er / more … than

subjects.display: 这本书比那本更有意思。
他的中文比我的英语差。
这个问题比上一个更难。

今天比昨天冷。 → Today is ____ than yesterday.

sentences.referenceExample: This book is more **interesting** than that one.

sentences.sentence: 地铁比公交快。 → The underground is ____ than the bus.
sentences.referenceExample: The underground is **faster** than the bus.

sentences.sentence: 我的房间比你的大。 → My room is ____ than yours.
这家餐馆比那家好。 → This restaurant is ____ than that one.
sentences.referenceExample: This restaurant is **better** than that one.

sentences.sentence: 英语比我想的容易。 → English is ____ than I thought.
这条路比那条更危险。 → This road is more ____ than that one.
sentences.referenceExample: This road is more **dangerous** than that one.

sentences.sentence: 他的中文比我的英语差。 → His Chinese is ____ than my English.
sentences.english: 他的中文比我的英语差。
sentences.referenceExample: His Chinese is **worse** than my English.

sentences.sentence: 夏天比冬天热。 → Summer is ____ than winter.
她比她姐姐年轻。 → She is ____ than her sister.
这个问题比上一个更难。 → This question is more ____ than the last one.
sentences.english: 这个问题比上一个更难。
sentences.referenceExample: This question is more **difficult** than the last one.

sentences.sentence: 我的手机比你的旧。 → My phone is ____ than yours.
今天的天气比昨天好。 → The weather today is ____ than yesterday.
sentences.referenceExample: The weather today is **better** than yesterday.

sentences.sentence: 坐飞机比坐火车贵。 → Flying is more ____ than taking the train.
sentences.referenceExample: Flying is more **expensive** than taking the train.

zh_en_a2_2_comparatives.helpMemoryIntro: 比较两个事物用比较级 + than（相当于中文的「比」）。

helpMemoryTips.title: 短词 +er，长词 more
helpMemoryTips.text: 单音节 +er（tall→taller）；多音节用 more（more expensive）。不规则：good→better，bad→worse。

zh_en_a2_2_continuous.title: 现在进行时（此刻）

subjects.display: 她正在写一封电子邮件。
她正在跑步。（run → 双写 n）
我正在给我妈妈做午饭。（make → making）

sentences.referenceExample: The children are **playing** in the park.

sentences.sentence: 我现在正在听音乐。 → I am ____ to music now.

sentences.referenceExample: I am **making** lunch for my mother.

zh_en_a2_2_continuous.helpMemoryIntro: 现在进行时（be + V-ing）表示此刻正在发生的动作，对应中文的「正在／在」。

helpMemoryTips.title: be + V-ing（Z18）
helpMemoryTips.text: 中文的「在」= 英语的进行时：我在学习 = I **am studying**。别漏掉 be 或 -ing。

五个鸡蛋 → five ____

zh_en_a2_2_count_uncount.helpMemoryIntro: 英语名词分可数和不可数。不可数名词没有复数，也不用 a/an。

helpMemoryTips.title: ⚠️ 不可数无复数（Z15）
helpMemoryTips.text: information / water / money / advice / furniture 都不可数：别说 an information 或 advices。

zh_en_a2_2_describing.title: 描述人和地方 · Adjectives
zh_en_a2_2_describing.helpMemoryIntro: 常用形容词。英语形容词放在名词前面。

helpMemoryTips.title: 形容词语序
helpMemoryTips.text: 多个形容词的顺序：观点 + 大小 + 年龄 + 颜色 + 名词（a beautiful old town）。

zh_en_a2_2_dict_shopping.title: 听写：Shopping & plans

zh_en_a2_2_dict_shopping.helpMemoryIntro: 听句子并打出来。注意冠词、复数和部分词。

helpMemoryTips.title: ⚠️ 冠词与复数（Z11/Z15）
helpMemoryTips.text: 写出 some / a、复数 -s，以及 a pair of 这样的部分词。

zh_en_a2_2_going_to.title: 将来计划：be going to

sentences.sentence: 我们打算在家吃饭。 → We're ____ to eat at home.

你们打算什么时候出发？ → When are you ____ to leave?
sentences.english: 你们打算什么时候出发？

sentences.sentence: 我不打算去那个派对。 → I'm not ____ to go to the party.

sentences.sentence: 她打算今年学英语。 → She's ____ to study English this year.

sentences.sentence: 看那些云，要下雨了。（有迹象的预测） → Look at those clouds — it's ____ to rain.

zh_en_a2_2_going_to.helpMemoryIntro: be going to 表示已经计划好的打算。

helpMemoryTips.title: be going to + 原形

zh_en_a2_2_listen_plans.title: 听力：Making plans
zh_en_a2_2_listen_plans.helpMemoryIntro: 先听，再答题。留意 be going to 和时间地点。

helpMemoryTips.title: 听将来计划
helpMemoryTips.text: I'm going to have a party、I'll cook——都是将来的安排。英式英语 flat = 公寓。

zh_en_a2_2_listen_plans.readingPassage: Hi Sam, it's Kate. Are you free this Saturday? I'm going to have a small party at my flat. It starts at seven in the evening. Tom is going to bring some music and I'll cook some food. Can you bring some drinks? Please call me back and let me know. See you soon!
zh_en_a2_2_listen_plans.readingPassageTranslation: 嗨 Sam，我是 Kate。这周六你有空吗？我打算在我家办一个小派对，晚上七点开始。Tom 会带些音乐来，我会做些吃的。你能带些饮料吗？请回个电话告诉我。回头见！

readingQuestions.question: What does Kate ask Sam to bring?
readingQuestions.questionTranslation: Kate 让 Sam 带什么？

zh_en_a2_2_partitives.title: 部分词：a piece / a cup of …

sentences.sentence: 一块蛋糕 → a ____ of cake

zh_en_a2_2_partitives.helpMemoryIntro: 要给不可数名词计数，就用「量词 + of」——这正是英语版的量词。

helpMemoryTips.title: 量词 → 部分词（Z16）
helpMemoryTips.text: 中文「三本书」的「本」在英语里对应 a piece of / a cup of / a pair of。用你已有的量词直觉。

zh_en_a2_2_quantifiers.title: much / many / some / any

subjects.display: 要不要来点咖啡？（客气提议用 some）

这里有多少人？ → How ____ people are here?

我没有时间。 → I don't have ____ time.

你有问题吗？ → Do you have ____ questions?
我想要一些茶。 → I would like ____ tea.
你认识多少个单词？ → How ____ words do you know?

sentences.referenceExample: There isn't **much** water in the bottle.

sentences.sentence: 要不要来点咖啡？（客气提议用 some） → Would you like ____ coffee?

你包里有笔吗？ → Do you have ____ pens in your bag?
sentences.referenceExample: Do you have **any** pens in your bag?

sentences.sentence: 他花了太多钱。 → He spent too ____ money.

zh_en_a2_2_quantifiers.helpMemoryIntro: 数量词要区分可数与不可数，还要看句子是肯定、否定还是疑问。

helpMemoryTips.title: ⚠️ many 还是 much？（Z15）
helpMemoryTips.text: many + 可数复数，much + 不可数；some 用于肯定，any 用于否定和疑问。

zh_en_a2_2_read_city.title: 阅读：City life vs country life
zh_en_a2_2_read_city.helpMemoryIntro: 读一段比较城市与乡村生活的短文。留意各种比较级。

helpMemoryTips.title: 比较级密集
helpMemoryTips.text: more jobs, quieter, cheaper, cleaner, friendlier, fewer——注意 fewer 用于可数。

zh_en_a2_2_read_city.readingPassage: Many people ask: is city life better than country life? In the city, there are more jobs, better shops, and lots of things to do. But cities are often noisy, crowded and expensive. In the country, life is quieter and cheaper. The air is cleaner and people are friendlier. However, there are fewer jobs and the shops are far away. In my opinion, the city is more exciting, but the country is more relaxing. The best place depends on the person.
zh_en_a2_2_read_city.readingPassageTranslation: 很多人会问：城市生活比乡村生活好吗？在城市里，工作更多、商店更好、可做的事也多。但城市往往吵闹、拥挤、昂贵。在乡村，生活更安静、更便宜，空气更清新，人们更友好。不过工作机会更少，商店也远。在我看来，城市更令人兴奋，乡村更让人放松。最好的地方因人而异。

readingQuestions.question: What is good about the city?
What is good about the country?

zh_en_a2_2_read_market.title: 阅读：Shopping in the market
zh_en_a2_2_read_market.helpMemoryIntro: 读一段逛市场的短文。留意可数/不可数名词和部分词。

helpMemoryTips.title: 部分词与比较级
helpMemoryTips.text: a kilo of apples、a loaf of bread；cheaper than（比…便宜）。英式货币 pounds。

zh_en_a2_2_read_market.readingPassage: On Sunday morning, Anna went to the market. It was busy and full of colour. She bought some fresh vegetables, a kilo of apples, and a loaf of bread. The apples were cheaper than in the supermarket. She also wanted some cheese, but there wasn't any. At a small shop, she found a beautiful scarf and bought it as a present. She spent thirty pounds and walked home happily.
zh_en_a2_2_read_market.readingPassageTranslation: 周日上午，Anna 去了市场。市场很热闹，五彩缤纷。她买了一些新鲜蔬菜、一公斤苹果和一条面包。这里的苹果比超市便宜。她还想买些奶酪，但没有了。在一家小店，她发现了一条漂亮的围巾，买下来当礼物。她花了三十英镑，高高兴兴地走回了家。

readingQuestions.question: What did Anna buy at the market?

zh_en_a2_2_speak_plans.title: 开口说：我的周末计划

subjects.display: This weekend, I'm going to go hiking.

We're going to watch a film.
On Sunday, I'll relax at home.

zh_en_a2_2_speak_plans.helpMemoryIntro: 说说你的周末计划。听并跟读，注意语调。

helpMemoryTips.title: ⚠️ 语调（Z9）
helpMemoryTips.text: 英语用音调高低表达态度和句型，而不是声调。一般疑问句句尾升调，陈述句降调。

zh_en_a2_2_speak_vowels.title: 发音：元音对立

subjects.display: sheep – ship, eat – it, seat – sit
bad – bed, sat – set, man – men

zh_en_a2_2_speak_vowels.helpMemoryIntro: 英语元音有长短、松紧之分，中文没有。听清楚 sheep 和 ship 的区别。

helpMemoryTips.title: ⚠️ 长短元音（Z6）
helpMemoryTips.text: /iː/（长）如 sheep ≠ /ɪ/（短）如 ship；/æ/ bad ≠ /e/ bed。读错元音会变成另一个词。

zh_en_a2_2_speaking_close.title: 结业对话：我的未来
zh_en_a2_2_speaking_close.helpMemoryIntro: A2.2 模块——也是 A 级——的结业对话：你的现在与未来。复制、开口、把分数带回来。

helpMemoryTips.title: 比较你的城市
helpMemoryTips.text: My city is smaller than…, but the food is better. 比较两座城市是展示本模块最自然的方式。

speaking.topic: An interview about my life now and my future: what I am doing these days, my plans for next year, and comparisons between my city and another city I like.
practisePoints: Present continuous for these days
going to and will for plans and promises
Comparatives and superlatives about places
some/any with shopping and food
priorityErrors: missing be in continuous or going to

zh_en_a2_2_speaking_mid.title: 对话：我的计划
zh_en_a2_2_speaking_mid.helpMemoryIntro: 中段检查点：把你的计划讲给 AI 助手听。复制、开口、把分数输回来。

helpMemoryTips.title: 一个计划一句话
helpMemoryTips.text: This weekend I'm going to visit my parents. Next month I'm going to start a course. 计划 + going to，直接说。

speaking.topic: A chat about my plans: what I am doing this week, what I am going to do next weekend, and my plans for the summer.
practisePoints: Present continuous for what is happening now / this week
going to for decided plans
will for spontaneous promises and predictions
scoringCriteria: going to vs will chosen sensibly
Time expressions: tomorrow, next week, this summer
priorityErrors: present simple used for right-now actions

zh_en_b1_1_articles_deep.title: 冠词进阶：抽象与泛指

zh_en_b1_1_bigtext.title: 整段填空：Ten years in London
zh_en_b1_1_bigtext.helpMemoryIntro: 完成短文：现在完成时还是过去时、for/since，以及动词后接 -ing 还是 to。

helpMemoryTips.title: 日期已封口，还是人生仍打开？
helpMemoryTips.text: in 2016、two months later → 过去时。for/since、ever、yet → 完成时。一空一判断。

zh_en_b1_1_bigtext.readingPassage: Mrs. Park has lived in London for ten years. She moved here in 2016, when she found a job at a language school. Since then she has taught hundreds of students. "I enjoy watching people grow," she says. She has never thought of changing jobs, but last year she decided to try something new: she signed up for a pottery class. "I have made fifty cups since September — and I have given most of them away to my students."
zh_en_b1_1_bigtext.readingPassageTranslation: 帕克太太在伦敦已经住了十年。她 2016 年搬来这里，当时在一所语言学校找到了工作。从那以后她教过几百名学生。"我喜欢看着人成长，"她说。她从没想过换工作，不过去年她决定尝试点新东西：报名了一门陶艺课。"从九月到现在我做了五十个杯子——大部分都送给了我的学生。"

zh_en_b1_1_listen_change.title: 听力：How life has changed
zh_en_b1_1_listen_change.helpMemoryIntro: 先听，再答题。留意现在完成时（has changed, has seen）。

helpMemoryTips.title: 完成时讲变化
helpMemoryTips.text: life has changed、she has seen——现在完成时把过去的变化和现在连起来。

zh_en_b1_1_listen_change.readingPassage: My grandmother often tells me how life has changed. When she was young, there were no mobile phones and no internet. People wrote letters and waited weeks for a reply. She has seen many changes in her life. Now she uses a smartphone to talk to her family in other cities. "Life is faster now," she says, "but I still miss the old days."
zh_en_b1_1_listen_change.readingPassageTranslation: 我奶奶常跟我说生活变了多少。她年轻时没有手机，也没有互联网。人们写信，要等上几周才有回信。她这一生见证了许多变化。现在她用智能手机和别的城市的家人通话。她说：「现在生活节奏快了，但我还是怀念过去的日子。」

readingQuestions.question: What didn't exist when the grandmother was young?

zh_en_b1_1_listen_podcast.title: 听力：A podcast on technology
zh_en_b1_1_listen_podcast.helpMemoryIntro: 先听，再答题。这段语速较自然，注意连读。

helpMemoryTips.title: 完成时 + 连读
helpMemoryTips.text: smartphones have changed；注意 a lot of、too much 的连读弱读。

zh_en_b1_1_listen_podcast.readingPassage: Welcome to Tech Talk. Today we're discussing how smartphones have changed our lives. Twenty years ago, phones were only for calls. Now, we use them for everything: shopping, banking, learning, and staying in touch with friends. But experts warn that we spend too much time looking at screens. Some studies show that people check their phones over a hundred times a day. So, our tip this week: try to put your phone away for one hour every evening.
zh_en_b1_1_listen_podcast.readingPassageTranslation: 欢迎收听《Tech Talk》。今天我们聊聊智能手机如何改变了我们的生活。二十年前，手机只能用来打电话。如今，我们用它做一切：购物、银行、学习、和朋友保持联系。但专家警告，我们花太多时间盯着屏幕。有研究显示，人们一天查看手机超过一百次。所以，本周的建议是：每天晚上试着把手机放开一个小时。

readingQuestions.question: What is the podcast about?
options: How smartphones have changed our lives

readingQuestions.question: What is the tip?
options: Put your phone away for an hour

zh_en_b1_1_pairs.helpMemoryIntro: 英语一个句子里这些连词只能用一个，而中文习惯成对使用。

helpMemoryTips.text: 规则动词的 V3 是 -ed；不规则要背：see→seen，be→been，lose→lost，do→done，write→written。

zh_en_b1_1_pp_vs_past.helpMemoryIntro: 这是中国学习者的一个难点。诀窍：用你熟悉的「了／过」来分辨。

helpMemoryTips.title: ⚠️ 用「过／了」分辨（Z18）
helpMemoryTips.text: 讲经历、无具体时间 → 现在完成（≈「过」：I have **been** to Japan）；有具体过去时间 → 过去式（I **went** last year）。

zh_en_b1_1_read_study.title: 阅读：Studying abroad
zh_en_b1_1_read_study.helpMemoryIntro: 读一段关于留学的短文。留意现在完成时与 however 的转折。

helpMemoryTips.title: 完成时 + 转折
helpMemoryTips.text: have chosen、has been；however 引出转折（相当于 but，但更正式）。

zh_en_b1_1_read_study.readingPassage: More and more Chinese students have chosen to study abroad in recent years. Studying in another country has many benefits. Students improve their language skills and learn about different cultures. They also become more independent. However, life abroad is not always easy. Many students feel homesick at first, and everyday tasks like cooking and shopping can be difficult in a new language. Experts advise students to join clubs and make local friends. "The first months are the hardest," one student said, "but it has been the best experience of my life."
zh_en_b1_1_read_study.readingPassageTranslation: 近年来，越来越多的中国学生选择出国留学。在异国学习有许多好处：学生能提高语言能力、了解不同文化，也会变得更独立。然而，海外生活并不总是轻松。许多学生起初会想家，做饭、购物这些日常小事在陌生语言里也会变难。专家建议学生参加社团、结交当地朋友。一位学生说：「最初几个月最难，但这是我人生中最棒的经历。」

readingQuestions.question: What is a benefit of studying abroad?

zh_en_b1_1_read_work.title: 阅读：The future of work
zh_en_b1_1_read_work.helpMemoryIntro: 读一段关于工作变化的短文。留意现在完成时和被动语态的雏形。

helpMemoryTips.title: 完成时讲近期变化
helpMemoryTips.text: has changed, has given, has created——现在完成时描述最近发生、影响至今的变化。

zh_en_b1_1_read_work.readingPassage: The way we work has changed a lot in recent years. In the past, most people worked in an office from nine to five. Now, many people work from home, using computers and video calls. This has given workers more freedom, but it has also created new problems. Some people feel lonely, and it is harder to separate work and home life. Experts say that in the future, more jobs will be done by machines. People will need new skills to stay useful. Learning, they say, will never stop.
zh_en_b1_1_read_work.readingPassageTranslation: 近年来我们的工作方式发生了很大变化。过去大多数人朝九晚五在办公室上班。如今，许多人在家办公，用电脑和视频通话。这给了员工更多自由，但也带来了新问题。有些人感到孤独，而且更难把工作和家庭生活分开。专家说，将来更多工作会由机器完成，人们需要新技能才能保持有用。他们说，学习永远不会停止。

readingQuestions.question: What is a problem of working from home?
What will people need in the future?

zh_en_b1_1_so_such.helpMemoryIntro: 这些词用来加强或说明程度，但搭配不同。

helpMemoryTips.title: 搭配
helpMemoryTips.text: so + 形容词；such + (a) + 名词；too + 形容词（过分，含否定意味）；形容词 + enough（足够）。

zh_en_b1_1_speak_ever.title: 开口说：Have you ever…?

subjects.display: Have you ever been to the UK?
I've never flown on a plane.

zh_en_b1_1_speak_ever.helpMemoryIntro: 用现在完成时谈论经历。听并跟读。

helpMemoryTips.title: 缩写
helpMemoryTips.text: I have → I've，you have → you've，has not → hasn't。口语里常缩写。

zh_en_b1_1_speak_stress.title: 发音：词重音与弱读

subjects.display: a REcord – to reCORD, a PREsent – to preSENT

I would like a cup of coffee, please.

zh_en_b1_1_speak_stress.helpMemoryIntro: 英语是重音节奏语言：一个词只有一个重读音节，其余弱读成 /ə/。这和音节等长的中文很不同。

helpMemoryTips.title: ⚠️ 一个重读 + 懒音（Z8）
helpMemoryTips.text: 重音会移动：PHOtograph → phoTOGrapher。非重读音节弱读成 /ə/（about, banana）。

zh_en_b1_1_speaking_close.title: 结业对话：我的轨迹
zh_en_b1_1_speaking_close.helpMemoryIntro: B1.1 模块的结业对话：一次关于你人生轨迹的采访。复制、开口、把分数带回来。

helpMemoryTips.title: 你的招牌句
helpMemoryTips.text: I've worked as a … for … years——这样自我介绍，半个模块的要点就已经展示完了。

speaking.topic: An interview about my life so far: how long I have done my job or studies, places I have lived, habits I used to have, and my opinions about learning English.
practisePoints: Present perfect + for/since for my current situation
Perfect for experience, past for the story details
used to for old habits
Giving opinions: I think, I agree, in my opinion
scoringCriteria: Opinions expressed with correct verb patterns
priorityErrors: used to confused with be used to

zh_en_b1_1_speaking_mid.title: 对话：我的经历
zh_en_b1_1_speaking_mid.helpMemoryIntro: 中段检查点：和 AI 助手聊聊你的人生经历。复制、开口、把分数输回来。

helpMemoryTips.title: 完成时-过去时二重奏
helpMemoryTips.text: 用 perfect 报幕（I have been to Xi'an），用过去时讲细节（I went in 2022）。这一来一回正是地道的 B1。

speaking.topic: A chat about my life experiences: places I have visited, foods I have tried, things I have never done but want to do.
practisePoints: Have you ever…? questions and natural answers
Present perfect for experience, past simple for the details
for/since with how long questions
priorityErrors: "I am here since" instead of "I have been here for/since"
aspect particles translated word for word (⚑Z aspect bridge)

zh_en_b1_2_bigtext.title: 整段填空：The night the lights went out
zh_en_b1_2_bigtext.helpMemoryIntro: 完成故事：过去进行时、used to、关系从句和一个条件句。

helpMemoryTips.title: 背景 -ing，事件简单过去
helpMemoryTips.text: 用 was/were + -ing 铺背景，用过去式点事件。这段文字会毫无预告地在两者之间切换。

zh_en_b1_2_bigtext.readingTitle: The night the lights went out
zh_en_b1_2_bigtext.readingPassage: It was a windy night and I was watching an old film at home. My street, which is usually noisy, was completely quiet. Suddenly the lights went out. While I was looking for a candle, someone knocked on the door. It was my neighbour, Mrs. Wang, who used to be an electrician. "If you lend me your torch, I will check the fuse box," she said. Ten minutes later the lights came back. Now, if the lights go out again, I know exactly who to call — the neighbour who saved my Friday night.
zh_en_b1_2_bigtext.readingPassageTranslation: 那是一个刮风的夜晚，我正在家看一部老电影。我住的那条平时很吵的街道完全安静了下来。突然停电了。我正找蜡烛时，有人敲门。是邻居王太太——她以前是电工。"你把手电借我，我去看看保险盒，"她说。十分钟后灯亮了。现在，如果再停电，我很清楚该找谁——那位拯救了我周五晚上的邻居。

zh_en_b1_2_cond1.helpMemoryIntro: 第一条件句讲将来可能发生的真实情况。

helpMemoryTips.title: ⚠️ if 从句用现在时（Z28）
helpMemoryTips.text: If it **rains**, I'll stay（不是 if it will rain）。if 从句里用现在时表将来，主句用 will。

zh_en_b1_2_dict_childhood.title: 听写：A childhood memory

subjects.display: When I was young, I lived in a village.
subjects.english: 我小时候住在一个村子里。

subjects.display: I will never forget that day.
subjects.english: 我永远不会忘记那一天。

subjects.display: The man who helped us was kind.
subjects.english: 帮助我们的那个人很善良。

subjects.display: If it rains tomorrow, we will stay at home.
subjects.english: 如果明天下雨，我们就待在家里。

subjects.display: I want to learn to swim.
She was cooking when the phone rang.
This is the park where we first met.
subjects.english: 这是我们初次见面的公园。
我叔叔当时正开车回家。

subjects.display: If you need help, call me.
subjects.english: 如果你需要帮助，就给我打电话。

subjects.display: The book that I bought is missing.

zh_en_b1_2_dict_childhood.helpMemoryIntro: 听句子并打出来。注意过去进行时、定语从句和动名词。

helpMemoryTips.title: ⚠️ 写出结构
helpMemoryTips.text: 注意 was/were + -ing，who/that 引导的从句，以及 -ing 动名词。

zh_en_b1_2_gerund.title: 动词 + 动名词

subjects.display: 他们一直问同一个问题。
我喜欢和朋友一起做饭。

sentences.sentence: 我喜欢游泳。 → I enjoy ____.
她做完了作业。 → She finished ____ her homework.
你介意开窗吗？ → Do you mind ____ the window?
我戒烟了。 → I gave up ____.
他不停地说话。 → He kept ____.
她喜欢在雨中散步。 → She enjoys ____ in the rain.
你介意等一会儿吗？ → Do you mind ____ a moment?
他做完饭了。 → He finished ____.
我们一直练习说英语。 → We keep ____ English.
我喜欢听播客。 → I enjoy ____ to podcasts.
他放弃了学钢琴。 → He gave up ____ the piano.
你介意关门吗？ → Do you mind ____ the door?
她做完了打扫。 → She finished ____.
他们一直问同一个问题。 → They keep ____ the same question.
sentences.english: 他们一直问同一个问题。

sentences.sentence: 我喜欢和朋友一起做饭。 → I enjoy ____ with my friends.
sentences.english: 我喜欢和朋友一起做饭。

zh_en_b1_2_gerund.helpMemoryIntro: 有些动词后面要用动名词（-ing），必须记住哪些。

helpMemoryTips.title: ⚠️ 用 -ing 的动词（Z26）
helpMemoryTips.text: enjoy / finish / mind / give up / keep + V-ing。中文动词直接叠加，英语要选对形式。

zh_en_b1_2_infinitive.title: 动词 + 不定式

sentences.sentence: 我想学英语。 → I want ____ English.
她决定出国。 → She decided ____ abroad.
我们计划早点出发。 → We plan ____ early.
他希望成功。 → He hopes ____.
我需要休息。 → I need ____.
她想当医生。 → She wants ____ a doctor.
他们决定买那套房子。 → They decided ____ the house.
我希望很快见到你。 → I hope ____ you soon.
我们需要早点起床。 → We need ____ up early.
他计划去欧洲旅行。 → He plans ____ to Europe.
她想换一份工作。 → She wants ____ her job.
我们决定不去了。 → We decided ____.
他需要多喝水。 → He needs ____ more water.
我希望明年再来。 → I hope ____ back next year.
sentences.referenceExample: I hope **to come** back next year.

sentences.sentence: 他们计划在春天结婚。 → They plan ____ married in spring.
sentences.referenceExample: They plan **to get** married in spring.

zh_en_b1_2_infinitive.helpMemoryIntro: 另一些动词后面要用不定式（to + 原形）。

helpMemoryTips.title: ⚠️ 用 to 的动词（Z26）
helpMemoryTips.text: want / decide / plan / hope / need + to + 原形。这些动词后不能用 -ing。

zh_en_b1_2_listen_announce.title: 听力：An announcement
zh_en_b1_2_listen_announce.helpMemoryIntro: 先听，再答题。车站广播语速偏快，抓住关键信息。

helpMemoryTips.title: 广播用语
helpMemoryTips.text: delayed（晚点）、platform（站台）、change at（换乘）。英式拼写 apologise。

zh_en_b1_2_listen_announce.readingPassage: Good morning, passengers. This is an announcement for the ten o'clock train to Manchester. We are sorry to inform you that this train is delayed by thirty minutes. The train will now leave from platform four, not platform two. Passengers travelling to Liverpool should change at Manchester. Thank you for your patience, and we apologise for any inconvenience.
zh_en_b1_2_listen_announce.readingPassageTranslation: 各位乘客早上好。这是十点开往曼彻斯特列车的通知。很抱歉地通知您，本次列车晚点三十分钟。列车现将从四号站台发车，而不是二号站台。前往利物浦的乘客请在曼彻斯特换乘。感谢您的耐心，对由此带来的不便我们深表歉意。

readingQuestions.question: Which platform will the train leave from?

zh_en_b1_2_listen_story.title: 听力：A short story
zh_en_b1_2_listen_story.helpMemoryIntro: 先听，再答题。注意过去进行时作背景。

helpMemoryTips.title: 背景动作
helpMemoryTips.text: while she was building a sandcastle（背景），she found a bottle（发生的事）。

zh_en_b1_2_listen_story.readingPassage: When Emma was a child, she lived in a small village by the sea. Every summer, she would spend the whole day on the beach. One afternoon, while she was building a sandcastle, she found an old bottle. Inside the bottle, there was a piece of paper with a message. It was a letter from a boy in another country. Emma wrote back, and they became friends by letter for many years. She still keeps that first message today.
zh_en_b1_2_listen_story.readingPassageTranslation: Emma 小时候住在海边一个小村庄。每年夏天，她都会在沙滩上玩一整天。一天下午，她堆沙堡时发现了一个旧瓶子。瓶子里有一张写着字的纸——那是另一个国家的一个男孩写的信。Emma 回了信，他们通过书信做了很多年的朋友。直到今天，她还保存着那第一封信。

readingQuestions.question: Where did Emma live as a child?
What did she find on the beach?
readingQuestions.questionTranslation: 她在沙滩上发现了什么？

readingQuestions.question: What happened next?
options: She made a friend by letter

zh_en_b1_2_past_cont.title: 过去进行时

subjects.display: 中午十二点你在吃午饭吗？
我们当时正朝车站走去。

sentences.sentence: 昨晚八点我在看电视。 → I was ____ TV at eight last night.
sentences.referenceExample: I was **watching** TV at eight last night.

sentences.sentence: 他们当时在踢足球。 → They were ____ football.
当时在下雨。 → It was ____.
你当时在做什么？ → What were you ____?
孩子们在花园里玩。 → The children were ____ in the garden.
sentences.referenceExample: The children were **playing** in the garden.

sentences.sentence: 她当时在写一封信。 → She was ____ a letter.
我们当时在听音乐。 → We were ____ to music.
他当时在花园里干活。 → He was ____ in the garden.
昨晚十点你在睡觉吗？ → Were you ____ at ten last night?
sentences.referenceExample: Were you **sleeping** at ten last night?

sentences.sentence: 我当时在等出租车。 → I was ____ for a taxi.
他们当时没在听。 → They weren't ____.
中午十二点你在吃午饭吗？ → Were you ____ lunch at twelve?
sentences.english: 中午十二点你在吃午饭吗？

sentences.sentence: 她当时正在学开车。 → She was ____ to drive.
我们当时正朝车站走去。 → We were ____ towards the station.
sentences.english: 我们当时正朝车站走去。

sentences.sentence: 整晚都在下雪。 → It was ____ all night.

zh_en_b1_2_past_cont.helpMemoryIntro: 过去进行时（was/were + V-ing）表示过去某个时刻正在进行的动作，常作背景。

helpMemoryTips.title: was/were + V-ing
helpMemoryTips.text: 强调「当时正在进行」：At eight, I was **watching** TV。常和 while 连用。

zh_en_b1_2_past_vs_cont.title: 过去式 vs 过去进行时

subjects.display: 他到的时候我们正在吃饭。
她跑步时遇到了一个老朋友。
你打电话来时我正在开会。
他开车时看见了一场事故。
我到家时他们正在吵架。
她睡觉时做了一个奇怪的梦。
我们等车时开始下雪了。

sentences.sentence: 我洗澡时电话响了。 → The phone rang while I was ____ a shower.
sentences.referenceExample: The phone rang while I was **having** a shower.

sentences.sentence: 他到的时候我们正在吃饭。 → When he arrived, we were ____ dinner.
sentences.english: 他到的时候我们正在吃饭。
sentences.referenceExample: When he arrived, we were **having** dinner.

sentences.sentence: 她走路时摔倒了。 → She ____ while she was walking.
我做饭时切到了手指。 → I cut my finger while I was ____.
sentences.referenceExample: I cut my finger while I was **cooking**.

sentences.sentence: 我们出门时下起了雨。 → It started to rain when we ____.
sentences.referenceExample: It started to rain when we **left**.

sentences.sentence: 他看书时睡着了。 → He ____ asleep while he was reading.
sentences.referenceExample: He **fell** asleep while he was reading.

sentences.sentence: 我们看电视时灯灭了。 → The lights ____ out while we were watching TV.
sentences.referenceExample: The lights **went** out while we were watching TV.

sentences.sentence: 她跑步时遇到了一个老朋友。 → She ____ an old friend while she was running.
sentences.english: 她跑步时遇到了一个老朋友。
sentences.referenceExample: She **met** an old friend while she was running.

sentences.sentence: 你打电话来时我正在开会。 → I was ____ a meeting when you called.
sentences.english: 你打电话来时我正在开会。
sentences.referenceExample: I was **having** a meeting when you called.

sentences.sentence: 他开车时看见了一场事故。 → He ____ an accident while he was driving.
sentences.english: 他开车时看见了一场事故。
sentences.referenceExample: He **saw** an accident while he was driving.

sentences.sentence: 我们聊天时她进来了。 → She ____ in while we were chatting.
sentences.referenceExample: She **came** in while we were chatting.

sentences.sentence: 他踢球时弄伤了腿。 → He ____ his leg while he was playing football.
sentences.referenceExample: He **hurt** his leg while he was playing football.

sentences.sentence: 我到家时他们正在吵架。 → They were ____ when I got home.
sentences.english: 我到家时他们正在吵架。
sentences.referenceExample: They were **arguing** when I got home.

sentences.sentence: 她睡觉时做了一个奇怪的梦。 → She ____ a strange dream while she was sleeping.
sentences.english: 她睡觉时做了一个奇怪的梦。
sentences.referenceExample: She **had** a strange dream while she was sleeping.

sentences.sentence: 我们等车时开始下雪了。 → It ____ to snow while we were waiting for the bus.
sentences.english: 我们等车时开始下雪了。
sentences.referenceExample: It **started** to snow while we were waiting for the bus.

zh_en_b1_2_past_vs_cont.helpMemoryIntro: 长的背景动作用过去进行时，突然打断的短动作用过去式。

helpMemoryTips.title: while + 进行，when + 过去
helpMemoryTips.text: while I **was having** a shower（背景），the phone **rang**（打断）。

zh_en_b1_2_phrasal.title: 短语动词（入门）

subjects.display: 你能照顾一下我的猫吗？
我在公交车站碰到了她。
我们到了酒店后再入住。（check in）
他在会上提出了一个好主意。（come up with）
别把音乐开那么大声。（turn up = 调大）

sentences.sentence: 我七点起床。 → I ____ up at seven.
请把灯打开。 → Please ____ on the light.
我在找我的钥匙。 → I'm ____ for my keys.
飞机起飞了。 → The plane ____ off.
别放弃！ → Don't ____ up!
请把电视关掉。 → Please ____ off the TV.
你能照顾一下我的猫吗？ → Can you ____ after my cat?
sentences.english: 你能照顾一下我的猫吗？

sentences.sentence: 我在公交车站碰到了她。 → I ____ into her at the bus stop.
sentences.english: 我在公交车站碰到了她。
sentences.referenceExample: I **ran** into her at the bus stop.

sentences.sentence: 把外套穿上。 → ____ on your coat.
我们查一下这个词吧。 → Let's ____ up this word.
快点，公交车来了，上车！ → Hurry, the bus is here — ____ on!
sentences.referenceExample: Hurry, the bus is here — **get** on!

sentences.sentence: 进屋请把鞋脱掉。 → Please ____ off your shoes inside.
我们到了酒店后再入住。（check in） → We'll ____ in when we arrive at the hotel.
sentences.english: 我们到了酒店后再入住。（check in）
sentences.referenceExample: We'll **check** in when we arrive at the hotel.

sentences.sentence: 他在会上提出了一个好主意。（come up with） → He ____ up with a good idea at the meeting.
sentences.english: 他在会上提出了一个好主意。（come up with）
sentences.referenceExample: He **came** up with a good idea at the meeting.

sentences.sentence: 别把音乐开那么大声。（turn up = 调大） → Don't ____ up the music so loud.
sentences.english: 别把音乐开那么大声。（turn up = 调大）
sentences.referenceExample: Don't **turn** up the music so loud.

zh_en_b1_2_phrasal.helpMemoryIntro: 短语动词由「动词 + 小品词」构成，意思常常不能从字面猜出。

helpMemoryTips.title: ⚠️ 成组记（Z30）
helpMemoryTips.text: turn on = 打开，look for = 寻找，give up = 放弃，take off = 起飞。中文没有这种结构，要整组背。

zh_en_b1_2_read_anecdote.title: 阅读：A true anecdote
zh_en_b1_2_read_anecdote.helpMemoryIntro: 读一个真实的小故事。留意过去进行时的背景和定语从句。

helpMemoryTips.title: 背景 + 定语从句
helpMemoryTips.text: was driving…when he saw（背景+打断）；a girl **who had lost** her dog（定语从句）。

zh_en_b1_2_read_anecdote.readingPassage: A few years ago, something strange happened to my uncle. He was driving home late one night when he saw a dog in the middle of the road. He stopped the car and got out. The dog looked frightened, so my uncle put it in his car and took it home. The next morning, he put up signs in the neighbourhood. A week later, a little girl who had lost her dog knocked on the door. She was crying with happiness. My uncle, who loves animals, was very glad to help. It is a story that our family still tells today.
zh_en_b1_2_read_anecdote.readingPassageTranslation: 几年前，我叔叔遇到了一件奇怪的事。一天深夜他开车回家，看见路中间有一只狗。他停下车下来。那只狗看起来很害怕，于是叔叔把它抱进车里带回了家。第二天早上，他在小区里贴了寻主启事。一周后，一个丢了狗的小女孩敲响了门，她高兴得哭了。爱护动物的叔叔非常乐意帮忙。这是一个我们家至今还常讲的故事。

readingQuestions.question: What did he do the next morning?
readingQuestions.questionTranslation: 第二天早上他做了什么？

zh_en_b1_2_read_city.title: 阅读：Protecting our city
zh_en_b1_2_read_city.helpMemoryIntro: 读一段环保故事。留意非限定定语从句和第一条件句。

helpMemoryTips.title: 从句 + 条件句
helpMemoryTips.text: the river, **which runs through the city**（补充信息）；If everyone helps, we can…（真实条件）。

zh_en_b1_2_read_city.readingPassage: Last year, a group of students in our city started a project to protect the environment. They noticed that the river, which runs through the city, was full of rubbish. Every weekend, they met by the river and cleaned it. At first, only ten students came, but soon hundreds of people joined. The local council, which was impressed by their work, gave them money for equipment. Today, the river is clean, and fish have returned. "If everyone helps," the leader said, "we can make a real difference."
zh_en_b1_2_read_city.readingPassageTranslation: 去年，我们城市的一群学生发起了一个保护环境的项目。他们注意到穿过城市的那条河里满是垃圾。每个周末，他们都在河边清理。起初只有十名学生参加，但很快就有数百人加入。当地议会对他们的工作印象深刻，出资购买了设备。如今，河水变干净了，鱼也回来了。带头的学生说：「只要人人出力，我们就能带来真正的改变。」

readingQuestions.question: What problem did the students notice?
options: The river was full of rubbish
readingQuestions.questionTranslation: 学生们注意到什么问题？

readingQuestions.question: What is the result?
options: The river is clean and fish returned

zh_en_b1_2_relative.title: 定语从句：who / which / that

subjects.display: 我买的那本书很有意思。

sentences.sentence: 我们住的房子很旧。 → The house ____ we live in is old.

sentences.sentence: 那个教我们英语的老师人很好。 → The teacher ____ teaches us English is very nice.
sentences.english: 那个教我们英语的老师人很好。
sentences.referenceExample: The teacher **who** teaches us English is very nice.

sentences.sentence: 你推荐的那部电影很棒。 → The film ____ you recommended was great.
sentences.english: 你推荐的那部电影很棒。
sentences.referenceExample: The film **that** you recommended was great.

sentences.sentence: 这是改变了我生活的一本书。 → This is a book ____ changed my life.
sentences.english: 这是改变了我生活的一本书。
sentences.referenceExample: This is a book **which** changed my life.

sentences.sentence: 偷了我手机的那个人被抓住了。 → The man ____ stole my phone was caught.
sentences.english: 偷了我手机的那个人被抓住了。
sentences.referenceExample: The man **who** stole my phone was caught.

sentences.sentence: 我们昨天吃的那家餐厅很贵。 → The restaurant ____ we ate at yesterday was expensive.

sentences.referenceExample: This is a job **which** needs patience.

sentences.sentence: 住在楼上的那对夫妇很安静。 → The couple ____ live upstairs are very quiet.
sentences.english: 住在楼上的那对夫妇很安静。
sentences.referenceExample: The couple **who** live upstairs are very quiet.

sentences.sentence: 你借给我的那把伞坏了。 → The umbrella ____ you lent me is broken.
sentences.english: 你借给我的那把伞坏了。
sentences.referenceExample: The umbrella **that** you lent me is broken.

zh_en_b1_2_relative.helpMemoryIntro: 定语从句用来修饰名词。英语把它放在名词**后面**，中文用「的」放在前面。

helpMemoryTips.title: ⚠️ 描述挂在名词后（Z23）
helpMemoryTips.text: 中文「我买的书」修饰语在前；英语 the book **that I bought** 放后面。人用 who，物用 which/that。

zh_en_b1_2_relative2.title: 定语从句：where / whose

subjects.display: 丢了钱包的男人很生气。
这是我们初次见面的餐厅。
我认识一个女孩，她爸爸是飞行员。
车被偷的那个女人报了警。
我们去了他们结婚的教堂。
我有个朋友，他的姐姐是歌手。
名字被念到的学生请站起来。
我们住过的那家酒店在海边。

zh_en_b2_1_bigtext.readingTitle: The mystery of the empty office
zh_en_b2_1_bigtext.readingPassage: When Xiaomei arrived on Monday, the office was empty. The lights had been left on all weekend and a window was open. "Someone must have been here," she thought. Her laptop was still on the desk, so it can't have been a thief — a thief would have taken it. Then she saw a note: "The pipes burst on Saturday. Everyone was told to work from home. The message was sent to all staff by email." Xiaomei sighed. If she had checked her inbox, she would have stayed in bed. Although the walk had woken her up, she would rather have spent it on a beach.

zh_en_b2_1_listen_science.readingPassage: Did you know that the human brain uses about twenty per cent of our energy, even though it is only two per cent of our body weight? Scientists have been studying the brain for centuries, but there is still a lot we don't understand. Recent research suggests that sleep is very important for memory. While we sleep, the brain organises the information we have learnt during the day. So, if you want to remember something, don't stay up all night — get some sleep!

zh_en_b2_1_read_ai.readingPassage: Artificial intelligence, or AI, has become part of our daily lives. It is used in phones, cars, hospitals and schools. Supporters say that AI makes life easier and can solve difficult problems, such as diseases and climate change. However, critics warn that AI also brings risks. Jobs may be lost, and if machines make important decisions, who is responsible when things go wrong? Many experts believe that AI should be controlled by clear rules. If it were used carefully, they argue, it could benefit everyone. The debate is far from over.
zh_en_b2_1_read_ai.readingPassageTranslation: 人工智能（AI）已经成为我们日常生活的一部分，被用于手机、汽车、医院和学校。支持者说 AI 让生活更方便，还能解决疾病、气候变化等难题。然而，批评者警告 AI 也带来风险：工作可能被取代；如果由机器做重要决定，出问题时谁来负责？许多专家认为，AI 应当受明确规则的约束。他们认为，只要谨慎使用，它就能造福所有人。这场辩论远未结束。

zh_en_b2_1_read_remote.readingPassage: Since the pandemic, remote work has become common in many companies. Employees who work from home save time and money because they don't have to travel. They can also have a better balance between work and family life. Companies benefit too: they can hire talented people from anywhere in the world and spend less on office space. However, remote work is not perfect. Some employees feel isolated, and teamwork can be harder online. Experts believe that in the future, many companies will use a 'hybrid' model, where staff work partly at home and partly in the office.
zh_en_b2_1_read_remote.readingPassageTranslation: 自疫情以来，远程办公在许多公司变得普遍。在家办公的员工省时省钱，因为不必通勤，也能更好地平衡工作与家庭。公司同样受益：可以在全球任何地方招募人才，办公空间的开支也更少。然而，远程办公并不完美。有些员工感到孤立，线上协作也更难。专家认为，未来许多公司会采用「混合」模式，员工一部分时间在家、一部分时间在办公室工作。

zh_en_b2_2_bigtext.readingPassage: On Monday Emma told her team that the client wanted changes. Tom understood that the client was unhappy, so he told Daniel that they would have to redo the design. Daniel said that it was impossible — they had run out of time. "You spoke to the client yourself, didn't you?" he asked Emma. "Well, no. Her assistant told me she had seen the drafts," Emma admitted. In the end, the client loved the design and had only asked them to change one colour. "I wish people would check the original message," Daniel sighed, "before a small comment turns into a crisis."

In the end, the client loved the design and had only asked them {{7}} change one colour. helpMemoryTips.title: 委婉与习语（Z32）
helpMemoryTips.text: 'read between the lines'（听出言外之意）；英语常用委婉语气代替直接的「不」。

zh_en_b2_2_read_culture.readingPassage: When Li Wei started working in London, he made an interesting discovery about British culture. In China, he was used to being direct. But his British colleagues often said things like 'That might be a bit difficult' when they actually meant 'no'. At first, Li Wei was confused. He thought people were unsure, but really they were being polite. He also noticed that the British apologise a lot, even when something is not their fault. Over time, Li Wei learnt to 'read between the lines'. He realised that understanding a culture is just as important as speaking the language.
zh_en_b2_2_read_culture.readingPassageTranslation: 李伟刚到伦敦工作时，对英国文化有了一个有趣的发现。在中国，他习惯直来直去。但他的英国同事常说「那可能有点难」，其实意思是「不行」。起初李伟很困惑，以为大家拿不定主意，其实他们是在委婉客气。他还注意到英国人很爱道歉，哪怕并不是他们的错。渐渐地，李伟学会了「听出言外之意」。他意识到，理解一种文化和会说这门语言同样重要。

readingQuestions.question: What did 'That might be difficult' really mean?
readingQuestions.questionTranslation: 「那可能有点难」其实是什么意思？

readingQuestions.question: What did he learn?
options: Culture matters as much as language

zh_en_b2_2_read_headline.readingPassage: Newspaper headlines are designed to catch our attention, but they don't always tell the whole story. Last week, one paper printed the headline: 'Robots to take all our jobs!' The article, which was much calmer than the headline, actually said that while some jobs will change, many new jobs will also be created. This is a common problem in the media. A shocking headline sells more papers, so writers often make things sound worse than they are. Experts advise readers to look beyond the headline and read the full story before forming an opinion. As the saying goes, 'Don't judge a book by its cover.'
zh_en_b2_2_read_headline.readingPassageTranslation: 报纸标题是为了吸引注意，但并不总是讲述事情的全貌。上周，一家报纸打出标题：「机器人将抢走我们所有的工作！」而那篇文章其实比标题冷静得多，说的是：虽然有些工作会改变，但也会创造出许多新工作。这是媒体的常见问题。耸动的标题更好卖，所以写手常把事情说得比实际更糟。专家建议读者别只看标题，先读完整篇再下结论。正如那句话所说：「别以封面评断一本书。」

readingQuestions.question: What is the problem with headlines?
What did the article really say?
options: New jobs will also be created

zh_en_c1_1_bigtext.title: 整段填空：The report
zh_en_c1_1_bigtext.helpMemoryIntro: 补全一份正式报告：名词化、模糊限定、被动与倒装。

helpMemoryTips.title: 报告腔
helpMemoryTips.text: 这里不说 I think：当家的是 it appears、the data suggest 和抽象名词。

zh_en_c1_1_bigtext.readingPassage: The decline of sales in the northern region appears to be linked to three factors. First, the late launch: the product was launched two months after our competitors'. Second, prices tend to be higher than the market average, a gap that has widened since January. Third, and arguably most damaging, the loss of two key partners in March. It could be argued that the region was under-resourced from the start. Not only did the team lack local knowledge — they also received the new materials late. Only in June did the situation begin to improve, and early figures suggest the recovery will make sense of the investment.
zh_en_c1_1_bigtext.readingPassageTranslation: 北部地区销售额的下滑似乎与三个因素有关。第一，上市过晚：产品比竞争对手晚了两个月。第二，价格往往高于市场均价，且差距自一月以来持续扩大。第三，也可能是伤害最大的一点：三月失去了两家关键合作伙伴。可以说，该地区从一开始就资源不足。团队不仅缺乏本地经验，新物料也拿得太晚。直到六月局面才开始好转，而初步数据显示，这轮复苏将让投入物有所值。

zh_en_c1_1_listen_lecture.title: 听力：A university lecture
zh_en_c1_1_listen_lecture.helpMemoryIntro: 先听，再答题。学术讲座里有名词化和被动结构。

helpMemoryTips.title: 学术语体
helpMemoryTips.text: decisions are influenced（被动）；is known as（被动）；decision-making（名词化）。

zh_en_c1_1_listen_lecture.readingPassage: Good morning. Today's lecture is about the psychology of decision-making. Many people believe that we make choices logically, weighing up the facts. However, research over the past few decades has shown that this is rarely the case. In fact, most of our decisions are influenced by emotion, habit, and the way information is presented. For example, if a product is described as '90% fat-free' rather than '10% fat', people are far more likely to buy it — even though the two statements mean exactly the same thing. This is known as the 'framing effect'.
zh_en_c1_1_listen_lecture.readingPassageTranslation: 早上好。今天的讲座讲的是决策心理学。许多人以为我们是理性地做选择、权衡事实。然而，过去几十年的研究表明，情况很少如此。事实上，我们的大多数决定都受到情绪、习惯以及信息呈现方式的影响。例如，如果一件产品被描述为「90% 无脂」而不是「含 10% 脂肪」，人们购买的可能性会大得多——尽管两种说法意思完全相同。这被称为「框架效应」。

zh_en_c1_1_listen_panel.title: 听力：A panel discussion
zh_en_c1_1_listen_panel.helpMemoryIntro: 先听，再答题。留意条件句和名词化。

helpMemoryTips.title: 条件 + 名词化
helpMemoryTips.text: If we fail to act, our cities will become…（条件）；the cost of doing nothing（名词化）。

zh_en_c1_1_listen_panel.readingPassage: Let's turn to our next topic: the future of cities. Professor Adams, you've argued that cities will become greener. Could you explain? — Certainly. As populations grow, we simply cannot continue building in the old way. Cities of the future will need vertical gardens, better public transport, and buildings that produce their own energy. — But isn't that expensive? — In the short term, yes. However, the cost of doing nothing would be far higher. If we fail to act, our cities will become unliveable.
zh_en_c1_1_listen_panel.readingPassageTranslation: 我们进入下一个话题：城市的未来。Adams 教授，您认为城市会变得更绿色，能解释一下吗？——当然。随着人口增长，我们不能再以旧方式建设。未来的城市需要垂直花园、更好的公共交通，以及能自己产能的建筑。——但那不是很贵吗？——短期内是的。然而，什么都不做的代价会高得多。如果我们不行动，城市将变得无法居住。

zh_en_c1_1_participle.helpMemoryIntro: 分词短语让句子更简洁，用来代替时间、原因或方式从句。

zh_en_c1_1_read_essay.title: 阅读：An argumentative essay
zh_en_c1_1_read_essay.helpMemoryIntro: 读一篇议论文。留意定语从句、名词化和论证连接词。

helpMemoryTips.title: 议论文结构
helpMemoryTips.text: in which…（定语从句）；Moreover / however（论证连接）；Investment…（名词化收尾）。

zh_en_c1_1_read_essay.readingPassage: Should university education be free? Supporters argue that free education creates a fairer society, in which talented students are not held back by their financial background. Moreover, a well-educated population benefits everyone, since it leads to a stronger economy and greater innovation. Opponents, however, point out that 'free' education is not really free: it is paid for through higher taxes. They also argue that if everyone can attend university, degrees may lose their value. In my view, while the cost is a genuine concern, the long-term benefits of an educated society outweigh the disadvantages. Investment in education is, quite simply, an investment in the future.
zh_en_c1_1_read_essay.readingPassageTranslation: 大学教育应该免费吗？支持者认为，免费教育造就更公平的社会，让有才华的学生不再因经济背景而受限。此外，受过良好教育的人口惠及所有人，因为它带来更强的经济和更多的创新。然而，反对者指出，「免费」教育其实并不免费：它靠更高的税收买单。他们还认为，如果人人都能上大学，文凭可能会贬值。在我看来，尽管成本是一个真实的顾虑，但受教育社会的长远收益超过其弊端。对教育的投资，说到底，就是对未来的投资。

zh_en_c1_1_read_ethics.title: 阅读：The ethics of technology
zh_en_c1_1_read_ethics.helpMemoryIntro: 读一段关于科技伦理的议论文。留意强调句、被动和名词化。

helpMemoryTips.title: 强调句 + 被动
helpMemoryTips.text: What is clear is that…（强调句）；can no longer be left（被动）；the questions it raises（省略 that 的从句）。

zh_en_c1_1_read_ethics.readingPassage: As technology advances, society faces increasingly difficult ethical questions. Consider the case of self-driving cars. If an accident is unavoidable, how should the car be programmed to react? Should it protect its passengers at all costs, or should it minimise the total number of injuries, even if that means harming its owner? There is no easy answer. What is clear, however, is that these decisions can no longer be left to engineers alone. Philosophers, lawmakers and the public must all be involved. The technology may be new, but the moral questions it raises are as old as humanity itself.
zh_en_c1_1_read_ethics.readingPassageTranslation: 随着科技进步，社会面临越来越棘手的伦理问题。以自动驾驶汽车为例：如果一场事故不可避免，汽车该被设定成如何反应？是不惜一切保护乘客，还是尽量减少总伤亡——哪怕这意味着伤及车主本人？这没有简单的答案。然而，有一点很清楚：这些决定不能再只交给工程师。哲学家、立法者和公众都必须参与其中。技术也许是新的，但它引发的道德问题，和人类本身一样古老。

readingQuestions.question: Who should be involved in the decisions?

speaking.topic: Present a topic you know deeply for several minutes, as if to an expert audience, then take challenging questions: defend your analysis with qualified, precise language.
practisePoints: A structured argument: causes, effects, qualifications
Formal register: nominalisations and collocations
Hedging under pressure: that may be true to some extent, but…
Emphasis with inversion where it counts

zh_en_c1_1_speaking_mid.title: 对话：分析一个趋势

helpMemoryTips.title: 按栏思考
helpMemoryTips.text: 原因 / 影响 / 限定语，各说一分钟——比十个零散观点更能体现 C1。

speaking.topic: An analytical discussion: pick a trend you know well (in your city, your industry or your generation), explain its causes and effects, and qualify your claims like an analyst.

One inversion for emphasis: Not only… but also…
scoringCriteria: Inversion used correctly at least once

zh_en_c1_2_bigtext.readingPassage: Dear Ms. Serrano, I am writing with regard to the delays affecting the Line 4 service. Having used this line daily for six years, I have never experienced disruption on the current scale. Trains are frequently cancelled without notice; moreover, passengers are rarely informed of alternatives. It was only through a fellow passenger that I learned of last week's timetable change. I must therefore request that a revised timetable be published and that refunds be issued for season-ticket holders. Admittedly, the service has improved slightly since March; that said, the current situation remains unacceptable. What passengers ultimately need is reliability, not apologies. I look forward to receiving your response. Yours sincerely, Wang Lei.
zh_en_c1_2_bigtext.readingPassageTranslation: 尊敬的 Serrano 女士：兹就影响 4 号线服务的延误问题致函于您。六年来我每天乘坐这条线路，从未经历过如今这种规模的中断。列车常常不加通知就被取消；此外，乘客几乎得不到替代方案的信息。上周的时刻表调整，我还是从另一位乘客那里才得知的。因此我必须要求：公布修订后的时刻表，并向持季票乘客发放退款。诚然，三月以来服务略有改善；话虽如此，目前的状况仍不可接受。乘客最终需要的是可靠，而不是道歉。盼复。王磊 谨上。

zh_en_c1_2_fronting.helpMemoryIntro: 把想强调的成分提到句首，让语气更有力，有时会引起倒装。

zh_en_c1_2_inversion.helpMemoryIntro: 否定或限制性副词放在句首时，主谓要倒装——这是正式、强调的写法。

zh_en_c1_2_listen_interview.title: 听力：A political interview
zh_en_c1_2_listen_interview.helpMemoryIntro: 先听，再答题。政治访谈中大量使用委婉和习语。

helpMemoryTips.title: 委婉 + 习语（Z31/Z32）
helpMemoryTips.text: I would say、too early to judge（委婉）；Rome wasn't built in a day（习语）；What I would ask…（强调句）。

zh_en_c1_2_listen_interview.readingPassage: Minister, thank you for joining us. Critics say your new housing policy has failed. How do you respond? — Well, I would say it's too early to judge. It is true that progress has been slower than we hoped. However, we've laid the foundations for long-term change. — But families are still waiting for homes. — I understand their frustration, and I share it. What I would ask is for a little more patience. Rome, as they say, wasn't built in a day. — Minister, thank you.
zh_en_c1_2_listen_interview.readingPassageTranslation: 部长，感谢您接受采访。批评者说您的新住房政策失败了，您怎么回应？——嗯，我会说现在下结论还为时过早。诚然，进展比我们希望的要慢。然而，我们已经为长期变革打下了基础。——但families仍在等待住房。——我理解他们的沮丧，我也感同身受。我想请求的是多一点耐心。正如人们所说，罗马不是一天建成的。——部长，谢谢您。

readingQuestions.question: How does the minister respond to criticism?

zh_en_c1_2_listen_negotiation.title: 听力：A business negotiation
zh_en_c1_2_listen_negotiation.helpMemoryIntro: 先听，再答题。留意谈判中的委婉条件句和使役结构。

helpMemoryTips.title: 条件 + 使役
helpMemoryTips.text: If you could reduce…we'd be prepared（委婉条件）；have the contract drawn up（使役被动）。

zh_en_c1_2_listen_negotiation.readingPassage: Thank you for meeting us. Let me be direct: we're very interested in your product, but the price is a concern. — I appreciate your honesty. What did you have in mind? — If you could reduce the price by ten per cent, we'd be prepared to sign a two-year contract. — That's a significant reduction. However, for a two-year commitment, I think we could offer eight per cent. — Let's say nine, and we have a deal. — Nine it is. I'll have the contract drawn up.
zh_en_c1_2_listen_negotiation.readingPassageTranslation: 感谢与我们会面。我就直说了：我们对贵方的产品很感兴趣，但价格是个顾虑。——感谢您的坦诚。您有什么想法？——如果您能把价格降低百分之十，我们愿意签一份两年的合同。——这个降幅可不小。不过，考虑到两年的承诺，我想我们可以让百分之八。——就九个点吧，成交。——那就九个点。我这就让人把合同拟好。

readingQuestions.question: What is the buyer concerned about?
What does the buyer offer in return for a discount?
What discount do they agree on?

zh_en_c1_2_read_column.title: 阅读：An opinion column

helpMemoryTips.title: 修辞语体
helpMemoryTips.text: so too does thought（倒装）；We would do well to…（委婉建议）；排比与对比增强说服力。

zh_en_c1_2_read_column.readingPassage: There is a growing tendency, especially among politicians, to speak in slogans rather than substance. Complex problems are reduced to three-word phrases, as if a catchy rhyme could solve a housing crisis or repair a broken health service. This, I would argue, is not merely lazy; it is dangerous. When language becomes empty, so too does thought. A society that stops demanding careful argument will, sooner or later, stop receiving it. We would do well to remember that the loudest voice is rarely the wisest, and that a simple answer to a difficult question is almost always the wrong one.
zh_en_c1_2_read_column.readingPassageTranslation: 有一种日益增长的倾向，尤其在政客中间：说口号，而非实质。复杂的问题被简化成三字短语，仿佛一句朗朗上口的顺口溜就能解决住房危机或修复崩坏的医疗系统。我要说，这不仅仅是懒惰，更是危险。当语言变得空洞，思想也随之空洞。一个不再要求缜密论证的社会，迟早也将不再得到缜密论证。我们最好记住：最大的嗓门很少是最智慧的，而对难题给出的简单答案，几乎总是错的。

readingQuestions.question: What is the writer's view of simple answers?

zh_en_c1_2_read_reviews.title: 阅读：Two reviews, two registers
zh_en_c1_2_read_reviews.helpMemoryIntro: 读两则语体截然不同的评价。本课的核心：语体意识。

helpMemoryTips.title: 语体对比（Z32）
helpMemoryTips.text: 正式：exquisite、considerable skill；非正式：well nice、defo、lol。流利 = 会在对的场合用对的语体。

zh_en_c1_2_read_reviews.readingPassage: Here are two reviews of the same restaurant. The first, from a food critic, reads: 'The dishes, though modest in appearance, reveal a chef of considerable skill; the balance of flavours is, quite frankly, exquisite.' The second, posted online by a customer, says: 'Food was well nice! A bit pricey but worth it lol. Will defo go back!' Both reviews are positive, yet they could hardly be more different. The first uses careful, formal language; the second is casual and full of slang. Neither is 'wrong'. Rather, each is appropriate to its context — and knowing which register to use, and when, is one of the true marks of fluency.
zh_en_c1_2_read_reviews.readingPassageTranslation: 这里有对同一家餐厅的两则评价。第一则出自美食评论家：「这些菜肴外表朴素，却显露出一位技艺不凡的厨师；风味的平衡，坦白说，堪称精妙。」第二则由一位顾客发在网上：「东西超好吃！有点小贵但值了 哈哈。绝对还会再去！」两则都是好评，却几乎再不同不过。前者用词讲究、正式；后者随意，满是俚语。两者都没有「错」。相反，各自都契合其语境——而知道该在何时使用哪种语体，正是真正流利的标志之一。

readingQuestions.question: How are the two reviews similar?
readingQuestions.questionTranslation: 两则评价有什么共同点？

readingQuestions.question: What is 'a true mark of fluency'?

zh_en_c1_2_speak_persuade.title: 发音：有说服力的语调

subjects.display: It is unfair, it is unwise, and it is unnecessary.
How much longer must we wait?
We can do better, and we must.

zh_en_c1_2_speak_persuade.helpMemoryIntro: 用停顿、重音和排比增强说服力；语调传达信念。

helpMemoryTips.title: 修辞节奏
helpMemoryTips.text: 三段排比、反问、恰当停顿，让讲话更有力量。

zh_en_c1_2_speak_register.title: 开口说：正式与非正式语体

subjects.display: Would you like me to assist you?
I'm afraid that won't be possible.
I was wondering if you could help me.

zh_en_c1_2_speak_register.helpMemoryIntro: 同一个意思，正式和非正式场合说法不同。听并跟读，感受差异。

helpMemoryTips.title: 语体的选择（Z32）
helpMemoryTips.text: 正式场合更委婉、更间接：Would you like me to assist you? vs Need a hand?

zh_en_c1_2_speaking_close.title: 结业对话：正式会谈
zh_en_c1_2_speaking_close.helpMemoryIntro: C1.2 模块的结业对话：一场从头到尾的正式会谈。复制、谈判、把分数带回来。

helpMemoryTips.title: 用模板开场
helpMemoryTips.text: Thank you for seeing me. I'd like to raise the issue of… ——这样的开场定下整场会谈的基调。

speaking.topic: A formal meeting roleplay: you present a complaint or proposal to a director (me), negotiate the details, and close with agreed next steps — all in high register.
practisePoints: Formal openings and closings: I am writing/calling with regard to…
Requests with formality: I must request that…, Would it be possible…
Cleft sentences to focus the key point
Discourse markers to structure the negotiation
priorityErrors: casual phrasal verbs in the formal meeting

zh_en_c1_2_speaking_mid.title: 对话：两副语体
zh_en_c1_2_speaking_mid.helpMemoryIntro: 中段检查点：同一件事，先穿便装讲，再穿西装讲。复制、开口、把分数输回来。

helpMemoryTips.title: 换动词就是换衣服
helpMemoryTips.text: find out → discover，ask for → request，sort out → resolve。十个动词换装，整个语体就转了。

speaking.topic: One story, two audiences: first tell me about a problem at work or in your studies as you would tell a friend; then re-tell exactly the same events as if reporting formally to a director.
practisePoints: The informal version: phrasal verbs, contractions, casual markers
The formal version: latinate verbs, nominalisations, passives
Keeping the facts identical while the register changes
scoringCriteria: Clear register contrast between the two versions
No register mixing within a version
priorityErrors: formal words in the casual version and vice versa
phrasal verbs in the formal report

helpMemoryTips.text: have done（强调结果）vs have been doing（强调过程/持续）；by then, I will have done。

zh_en_c2_1_bigtext.title: 整段填空：The review
zh_en_c2_1_bigtext.helpMemoryIntro: 补全一篇带英式反讽的餐厅评论：习语、轻描淡写和精细情态。

helpMemoryTips.title: 先读出语气
helpMemoryTips.text: 这篇评论踩着刹车夸、带着微笑批。每个空都要维持这个温度。

zh_en_c2_1_bigtext.readingPassage: The Golden Fork is not exactly cheap — dinner for two cost an arm and a leg — but the cooking is not bad at all. The famous fish pie may well be the best in the city, though the waiter who described it for six full minutes was, shall we say, none too brief. Service is a bit of a problem: our starters arrived before the menus, and the wine never arrived at all. "It slipped my mind," the waiter admitted, which at least had the charm of honesty. Would I go back? I think so. The chef clearly knows his craft, and at the end of the day, one forgives a great deal for pastry like that. But I might as well book somewhere quieter for the conversation.
zh_en_c2_1_bigtext.readingPassageTranslation: "金叉子"确实算不上便宜——两人晚餐花了大价钱——但菜做得着实不坏。招牌鱼派很可能是全城最好的，只是那位足足介绍了六分钟的服务员，怎么说呢，不太"简短"。服务有点小状况：前菜比菜单先上，酒则始终没来。"我完全忘了，"服务员承认——至少这份诚实还算可爱。会再去吗？我想会的。主厨的手艺明摆着，说到底，为那样的酥皮可以原谅很多。不过想好好聊天的话，我还是不如订个安静点的地方。

helpMemoryTips.text: 写出 not so much…as…、Had we…、to put it mildly、What matters is…。

helpMemoryTips.title: ⚠️ 别逐字直译（Z32）
helpMemoryTips.text: 习语是文化的结晶：a piece of cake（小菜一碟）、cost an arm and a leg（花大价钱）。

zh_en_c2_1_listen_irony.title: 听力：Irony & humour
zh_en_c2_1_listen_irony.helpMemoryIntro: 先听，再答题。关键是听出反讽——说的和真正的意思相反。

helpMemoryTips.title: ⚠️ 反讽（Z31）
helpMemoryTips.text: 'Truly, we are living in the future' 是反讽：字面在夸，实则在讽刺。靠语气和上下文判断。

zh_en_c2_1_listen_irony.readingPassage: So, I bought one of those 'smart' home devices last month. You know, the ones that are supposed to make your life easier. Well, let me tell you how my morning went. I asked it to turn on the lights. It played jazz. I asked it to play music. It ordered fifty rolls of toilet paper. And when I finally, in desperation, shouted 'Help!', it cheerfully replied: 'I'm sorry, I didn't quite catch that.' Truly, we are living in the future.
zh_en_c2_1_listen_irony.readingPassageTranslation: 话说，我上个月买了那种「智能」家居设备。你懂的，就是号称能让生活更轻松的那种。来，让我说说我那天早上过得怎么样。我叫它开灯，它放起了爵士乐。我叫它放音乐，它订了五十卷厕纸。最后我绝望地喊「救命！」，它欢快地回答：「抱歉，我没太听清。」我们，真是活在未来啊。

readingQuestions.question: What is the speaker really saying about the device?
readingQuestions.questionTranslation: 说话人其实在说这个设备怎么样？

readingQuestions.question: Is the speaker being serious at the end?

zh_en_c2_1_listen_literary.title: 听力：A literary reading
zh_en_c2_1_listen_literary.helpMemoryIntro: 先听，再答题。留意营造氛围的文学手法。

helpMemoryTips.title: 文学手法（Z31）
helpMemoryTips.text: 拟人（windows seemed to follow you）、氛围营造、留白——不解释反而更有力。

zh_en_c2_1_listen_literary.readingPassage: Listen to this short passage. 'The old house stood at the end of the lane, silent and watchful, as it had for a hundred years. Its windows, dark and empty, seemed to follow you as you passed. The villagers said nothing lived there now — nothing, at least, that they cared to name. But on winter nights, when the wind was still, a single light would sometimes appear in the highest window, and then, just as quickly, be gone.' Notice how the writer creates a feeling of mystery without ever explaining what is really there.
zh_en_c2_1_listen_literary.readingPassageTranslation: 听这一小段文字：「那座老屋伫立在小巷尽头，沉默而警觉，一如它百年来的模样。它那一扇扇黑洞洞、空荡荡的窗户，似乎在你经过时目送着你。村民说如今那里什么都不住了——至少，没有他们愿意说出名字的东西。可在冬夜，风止之时，最高的那扇窗里有时会亮起一盏孤灯，随即，又同样迅速地熄灭。」注意作者如何在从不解释的情况下营造神秘感。

readingQuestions.question: What kind of text is this?
What feeling does the writer create?
Does the writer explain the light?

zh_en_c2_1_marked.helpMemoryIntro: 用助动词 do、强调句和否定倒装突出信息、加强语气。

helpMemoryTips.title: 强调手段（Z22）
helpMemoryTips.text: 用 do 强调肯定（I **did** tell you）；强调句 It is…that…；否定倒装。

zh_en_c2_1_pv_networks.title: 短语动词网络：put

helpMemoryTips.title: put 的家族（Z30）
helpMemoryTips.text: put up with（忍受）、put off（推迟）、put out（扑灭）、put through（接通）、put down（放下）。

zh_en_c2_1_read_review.title: 阅读：A book review with irony
zh_en_c2_1_read_review.helpMemoryIntro: 读一篇带反讽的书评。留意「明褒暗贬」的手法。

helpMemoryTips.title: 明褒暗贬（Z32）
helpMemoryTips.text: 'towering achievement' → 转为吐槽篇幅；'something shorter' 是含蓄的贬评。识别反语与低调陈述。

zh_en_c2_1_read_review.readingPassage: Mr Pinter's new novel, we are told, is a 'towering achievement'. It is certainly towering in length: at nine hundred pages, it could comfortably serve as a doorstop. The plot, such as it is, follows a middle-aged professor who spends the entire book deciding whether or not to buy a new hat. Along the way, we are treated to forty pages on the history of felt. Admirers will call this 'meditative'; the rest of us may call it something shorter. And yet — I confess — I read to the end. Perhaps, buried beneath the endless description, there is a real story struggling to get out. Or perhaps I simply wanted to know about the hat.
zh_en_c2_1_read_review.readingPassageTranslation: 据说，Pinter 先生的新小说是一部「巍峨的杰作」。它在篇幅上确实巍峨：九百页，完全可以当门挡用。至于情节——如果那也算情节的话——讲的是一位中年教授用整本书来纠结要不要买一顶新帽子。一路上，我们还「有幸」读到四十页关于毡子历史的内容。仰慕者会称之为「冥想式」；我们其余人也许会用一个更短的词来形容。然而——我承认——我读到了最后。也许，在无尽的描写之下，真有一个故事在挣扎着想冒出来。又或者，我只是想知道那顶帽子到底怎样了。

readingQuestions.question: What is the reviewer's real opinion?
readingQuestions.questionTranslation: 评论者真正的看法是什么？

readingQuestions.question: What is the joke about the book's length?
readingQuestions.questionTranslation: 关于篇幅的玩笑是什么？

readingQuestions.question: Does the reviewer finish the book?
readingQuestions.questionTranslation: 评论者读完这本书了吗？

zh_en_c2_1_read_satire.title: 阅读：A satirical article
zh_en_c2_1_read_satire.helpMemoryIntro: 读一篇讽刺文章。关键是识别夸张背后的讽刺，别当真。

helpMemoryTips.title: ⚠️ 讽刺文体（Z31）
helpMemoryTips.text: 用荒诞的夸张来批评现实观点（「快乐是简单的选择」）。识别出它并非字面真实。

zh_en_c2_1_read_satire.readingPassage: In a bold move to improve public health, the government has announced that from next year, all citizens will be required to feel happy at all times. Frowning in public will carry a small fine, while excessive sighing may result in a mandatory 'joy workshop'. A spokesperson explained: 'We believe happiness is a simple choice. If people are unhappy, it is clearly their own fault.' Critics have pointed out that poverty, stress and poor healthcare might have something to do with it — but such negativity, the government insists, is exactly the problem. The scheme will be funded by a new tax on umbrellas, since rain, too, has been declared unpatriotic.
zh_en_c2_1_read_satire.readingPassageTranslation: 为改善公众健康，政府大胆宣布：从明年起，全体公民必须时刻感到快乐。在公共场合皱眉将被处以小额罚款，而过度叹气可能被强制参加「快乐工作坊」。一位发言人解释道：「我们认为快乐是一个简单的选择。如果人们不快乐，那显然是他们自己的错。」批评者指出，贫困、压力和糟糕的医疗或许与此有关——但政府坚称，这种消极情绪正是问题所在。该计划将由一项新的雨伞税提供资金，因为下雨也已被宣布为不爱国。

readingQuestions.question: Is this article describing a real policy?
readingQuestions.questionTranslation: 这篇文章在描述真实政策吗？

readingQuestions.question: What is the article criticising?
options: The idea that happiness is just a choice

zh_en_c2_1_speak_fluency.title: 发音：习语与自然节奏

subjects.display: To be honest, I couldn't care less.

zh_en_c2_1_speak_fluency.helpMemoryIntro: 地道流利 = 习语 + 自然节奏 + 连读弱读。像母语者一样把词连起来。

helpMemoryTips.title: ⚠️ 流利的节奏（Z10）
helpMemoryTips.text: 习语脱口而出、功能词弱读、词与词连读——这才是接近母语的语感。

zh_en_c2_1_speak_prosody.title: 发音：韵律与态度

subjects.display: Oh, great. Just what I needed.

zh_en_c2_1_speak_prosody.helpMemoryIntro: 同一句话，语调不同，态度（真诚、讽刺、犹豫）就不同。

helpMemoryTips.title: 语调即态度（Z9）
helpMemoryTips.text: "Oh, great" 可以真诚，也可以讽刺——全看语调。用声音传达真正的意思。

zh_en_c2_1_speaking_close.title: 结业对话：幽默与分寸
zh_en_c2_1_speaking_close.helpMemoryIntro: C2.1 模块的结业对话：用英式的从容讲一场"灾难"。复制、开口、把分数带回来。

helpMemoryTips.title: 给形容词踩刹车
helpMemoryTips.text: 想说 terrible 的地方，说 "not ideal"。C2 的听众听得出刹车，也就听得出事情的分量。

speaking.topic: Tell me about a disaster that turned out fine — a trip, a meal, a project — told with irony and understatement, British style. Then we review a plan together and you push back with softened but firm disagreement.
practisePoints: A story told with understatement and irony
Idioms placed naturally at key moments
Ellipsis in the back-and-forth: so do I, I hope not, neither did we
Firm but soft disagreement
scoringCriteria: Humour lands through language, not volume
priorityErrors: full sentences where a native would use two words

zh_en_c2_1_speaking_mid.title: 对话：听懂弦外之音
zh_en_c2_1_speaking_mid.helpMemoryIntro: 中段检查点：一场话里有话的闲聊。复制、对话、把分数输回来。

helpMemoryTips.title: 每场两个习语
helpMemoryTips.text: 放在真正合适的位置，然后收手。三个自然的习语胜过十个硬塞的。

speaking.topic: A conversation full of understatement and idioms: we chat about work, houses and plans; I will underplay everything and you must respond to what I mean, not what I say — and use idioms naturally yourself.
practisePoints: Decoding understatement and responding to the real meaning
Using three or four idioms naturally, not forced
Fine modality: may well, might as well, needn't have
scoringCriteria: Idioms used accurately and in context

zh_en_c2_2_bigtext.title: 整段填空：The graduation address
zh_en_c2_2_bigtext.helpMemoryIntro: 最后一篇整段填空：修辞、倒装、语体与最终的细节陷阱——整门课浓缩在一页里。

helpMemoryTips.title: 课程收官
helpMemoryTips.text: 每个空都是你已经掌握的一个模块。通读、享受、收尾。

zh_en_c2_2_bigtext.readingPassage: Friends, we gather to celebrate not an ending but a beginning. Never has this room held so much hard-won knowledge. You arrived unable to order a coffee; you leave able to argue, to joke, to switch between registers as easily as you change shoes. Life is short, and people are generous with their patience — so speak, and speak badly when you must, because it was the mistakes that taught you the most. Having climbed this far, you may well wonder what comes next. In other words, everything. Eventually every learner realises the secret: nobody is finished. Not the teachers, not the natives, not even the poets. What we call mastery is simply curiosity that refused to give up. Congratulations — now go and use it.
zh_en_c2_2_bigtext.readingPassageTranslation: 朋友们，我们相聚于此，庆祝的不是终点，而是起点。这间屋子从未装下过这么多来之不易的学识。你们来时连一杯咖啡都点不了；离开时已能辩论、能开玩笑、能像换鞋一样在语体之间切换。人生苦短，而人们对耐心却慷慨——所以去说吧，必要时就说得磕磕绊绊，因为教你最多的恰恰是那些错误。爬到这里，你们大概会想：接下来是什么？换句话说：是一切。终有一天，每个学习者都会明白这个秘密：没有人是"学完了"的。老师没有，母语者没有，连诗人也没有。我们所谓的精通，不过是不肯认输的好奇心。祝贺你们——现在，去用它吧。
